cards.text: Friend, Genesis 1 was the wide shot. Now this is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, and we're zooming in CLOSE. No shrub has appeared, no plant has sprouted, and the ground is just sitting there like an empty cookie sheet.

cards.question: Why hasn't a single plant of the field sprouted yet?

answers.text: No rain yet and no man to work the ground
The waters still cover all the dry land
The sun has not been set in the sky

cards.question: No rain has fallen on the earth yet. So how does the ground get watered?

answers.text: Springs well up from the earth
Dew settles on it every morning

cards.text: The ground is watered and waiting. Then the LORD God forms the man, and He doesn't use gold or marble. He uses something WAY more humble.

cards.question: What does the LORD God form the man from?
The LORD God has formed the man, but the man isn't a living being yet. What does the LORD God do next?

answers.text: Breathes the breath of life into his nostrils
Speaks a blessing over the top of his head
Washes him clean in the waters of the spring

cards.text: Dust to a living being in ONE breath, and I sat under dust in a junk drawer for YEARS and all it did was make me look older. Now the LORD God plants a garden in Eden, in the east, and places the man right there.

cards.question: Out of the ground in Eden, the LORD God grows every kind of tree. What are the trees like?

answers.text: Pleasing to the eye and good for food
Tall enough to reach into the clouds
Bare until the first rain comes down

cards.text: And in the middle of the garden stand two trees: the tree of life, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. Keep your eye on those two, friend.

A river flows out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branches into four: the Pishon, the Gihon, the Tigris and the Euphrates. The Pishon winds through the land of Havilah, where the gold is pure. I came out of a 25 cent bin, so that verse hits DIFFERENT.
Then the LORD God takes the man and places him in the Garden of Eden. And he is NOT there on vacation.

cards.question: What does the LORD God place the man in the Garden of Eden to do?

answers.text: To build a city by the river
To hunt in the open field

cards.text: First job in history, and he never has to sit in traffic to get there. Then the LORD God gives the man a command.

cards.question: The LORD God tells the man he may eat freely from every tree of the garden except one.
Which tree does the LORD God tell the man he must not eat from?

answers.text: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil
The tree of life in the middle of the garden
The tallest fig tree growing by the river

cards.question: The LORD God warns the man: "for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely ___."

cards.text: All through Genesis 1, God keeps seeing that what He made is good. Now, for the first time, the LORD God says something is NOT good.

cards.question: What does the LORD God say is not good?

answers.text: For the man to be alone
For the garden to go without rain
For the animals to roam untamed

cards.question: The LORD God has a plan for the man who is alone: "I will make for him a suitable ___."

cards.text: Then out of the ground the LORD God forms every beast of the field and every bird of the air. And He brings them to the man.

cards.question: Why does the LORD God bring the beasts and the birds to the man?

answers.text: To see what he would name each one
To teach him how to care for them
To let him pick which ones to keep

cards.text: Whatever the man calls each living creature, that's its name. I named six cookie cutters and it took me FOREVER, and this man is naming the whole parade with no do-overs.

cards.question: After naming all the livestock, birds and beasts, the man finds a suitable helper among them.

cards.text: Every creature named, and not one is a match for Adam, the man. So the LORD God causes him to fall into a deep sleep.

cards.question: While the man sleeps, what does the LORD God take from him?

cards.text: Then He closes up the spot with flesh. Greatest surgery ever: no waiting room, no paperwork, and the patient sleeps through the WHOLE thing.

cards.question: From the rib He took, the LORD God makes a ___ and brings her to the man.

cards.text: After that whole parade of animals, the man finally speaks. He says she's bone of his bones and flesh of his flesh, and I bet you could hear the relief clear across the garden.

cards.question: The man says she shall be called woman. Why that name?

answers.text: Because she was taken out of man
Because she was made last of all
Because God gave her that name

cards.text: Then the passage explains: for this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife.

cards.question: When a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, the two of them will become one ___.
The man and his wife are both naked, and they are ashamed.

cards.text: Naked and not ashamed. Not one crumb of it. And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend, but keep that apron on, because this story is NOT done.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 16 quotes "for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely ___.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 3 quotes "I will make for him a suitable ___.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: Stop 1 has 9 choice cards: 7 multiple choice, 1 true or false and 1 fill in the blank. Multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: "Genesis 1 was the wide shot. Now ... we're zooming in CLOSE" states how Genesis 2 relates to Genesis 1. Neither text says this. The Genesis 1 claim also has no reference, and the card cites only Genesis 2:4-5.

rule.text: Connecting passages. When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state.

findings.problem: "All through Genesis 1, God keeps seeing that what He made is good" is a Bible fact from outside the passage, but it has no reference. The card cites only Genesis 2:18.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: "I named six cookie cutters and it took me FOREVER" adds a new detail to his backstory in the Millers' kitchen. The backstory only says he gave each of them a name. Made-up moments in jokes are allowed only around his bakery.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.

findings.problem: "After that whole parade of animals, the man finally speaks" implies the man hadn't spoken before. In Genesis 2:19-20 the man calls each living creature by name, so the text shows him speaking earlier.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The story-continues line "And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend" nearly copies the doc's example line, "And that's where we'll leave it for now. Trust me, friend, this story's not done."

rule.text: The examples show the idea. Write your own line each time.
